content.comment_body: Sales and delivery have begun for hardware release 03 and firmware [version_no] for [product_name] ([article_no]) and [product_name] ([article_no]). This new hardware version is now available for both products. For manufacturing purposes, firmware [version_no] is introduced alongside hardware release 03. Product description: The [product_name] modules in conjunction with [product_name] logic modules or operating independently provide a cost-effective solution for remote monitoring and control of distributed systems via text messages, emails, and phone calls. Modules with hardware release 03 will be shipped from the factory with firmware [version_no]. Hardware release 03 and firmware [version_no] perform identically to hardware release 02 and firmware [version_no]. This update is purely for production purposes. The firmware [version_no] will not be available for download.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are notified about the release of new hardware and firmware for [product_name] modules, with functionality matching previous versions. The firmware will be pre-installed on new devices, but is not provided as a downloadable update. This approach focuses on production process rather than introducing new features, which might lead to uncertainty for users who anticipate downloadable firmware updates or clear information about release differences.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate transparent communication about differences between product versions, clarity on available features, and guidance regarding firmware downloads. Transparency regarding why the firmware is not offered for download is also expected.
